traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two
with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15
(2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11
(2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
The dragon exhales steam in a 30 cone.
Creatures in the area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On
a failed saving throw, the creature takes 52 (15d6) fire damage, or half as
much damage on a successful saving throw. Being underwater doesn’t
grant resistance to this damage.
